# Character Dossier & Quick Sheet

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
from sr6core.character.manager import CharacterManager
from sr6core.publishing.quick_sheet import export_quick_sheet

cm = CharacterManager()
char_data = cm.get_character_data("reiko") or {}
repo_dir = cm.get_character_repo_dir("reiko")

sheet_txt = export_quick_sheet(char_data, char_repo_path=repo_dir)
```
